text: Kor'kron Emberguards are orcs of Kor'kron located during the Secrets of Ragefire scenario.
Kor'kron Generals are orcs of Kor'kron located in Icecrown Citadel.

Kor'kron Assailants are orcs of the Kor'kron located during the A Little Patience scenario. They are airdropped in massive numbers all over the area but are all soon defeated by the various traps laid by the adventurers and their crew in the jungle.
Kor'kron Shadowblades are orcs of Kor'kron located during the Secrets of Ragefire scenario.
Kor'kron Rocketeers are goblins of Kor'kron located in Icecrown Citadel.
Kor'kron Sergeants are taunka of Kor'kron located in Icecrown Citadel.
__NOTOC__ Kor'kron Soulbreakers are orc warlocks of the Kor'kron located at Echo Isles of Durotar during The Horde Is Family.
Kor'kron Transport Pilots are orcs of Kor'kron located at Icecrown.
__NOTOC__ Kor'kron Stalkers are orcs of Kor'kron located in Icecrown Citadel.
Kor'kron Subjugators are orcs of Kor'kron located at Echo Isles of Durotar. After the trolls are freed, one subjugator is brought to Thrall.
Koak is the rider and friend of the cloud serpent Steel and one of the few known Dragonmaw orcs to remain within the Horde following its civil war.
__NOTOC__ Kor'kron Spire of Supremacy drops from Garrosh Hellscream in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
__NOTOC__ Kor'kron Elite Skullmask drops from Garrosh Hellscream in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
The Kor'kron Juggernaut is a mechanical scorpion mount, a miniature version of the massive Iron Juggernaut that guarded the Gates of Orgrimmar.
Kor'kron Meat Racks are racks of meat found in the Kor'kron meat camp of Northern Barrens. They contain 1-2 Kor'kron Meat.
Kor'kron Meat Crates are crates of meat found spilled all over the ground when an Overturned Kor'kron Caravan happens in Northern Barrens. Each crate contains 1-2 Kor'kron Meat.

Kor'kron Stone Crates are crates of stone found spilled all over the ground when an Overturned Kor'kron Caravan happens in Northern Barrens. These crates are also found all over the Kor'kron elemental camp. Each crate contains 1-2 Kor'kron Stone.
Kor'kron Lumber Crates are crates of lumber found spilled all over the ground when an Overturned Kor'kron Caravan happens in Northern Barrens. Each crate contains 1-2 Kor'kron Lumber.
Kor'kron Oil Drum are drums of oil found in the Kor'kron refinery of Northern Barrens. They contain 1-2 Kor'kron Oil.
Kor'kron Oil Barrels are drums of oil found spilled all over the ground when an Overturned Kor'kron Caravan happens in Northern Barrens. Each drum contains 1-2 Kor'kron Oil.
Kor'kron Shadowmages are level 91 orcs found in Orgrimmar during the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Kor'kron Reapers are Mag'har orcs found in the last Rough-Hewn Passage during the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Kor'kron Warbringers are Mag'har orcs found in The Inner Sanctum during the Siege of Orgrimmar. They take part in the Garrosh Hellscream encounter.

Kor'kron Elite Snipers are Kor'kron orcs that took part in the defense of Bladefist Bay during the Siege of Orgrimmar. During the Galakras encounter, these elite marksmen set up just beyond the anti-air towers and neutralized any enemy forces that tried to get past Galakras. After Galakras's defeat, they retreated.
Kor'kron Cannons are mechanical cannons used by the Kor'kron at Dranosh'ar Landing in the Siege of Orgrimmar prior to the Galakras encounter.
Kor'kron Dire Wolves are dire wolves seen in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Kor'kron War Wolves are wolves seen in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Kor'kron Den Mothers are wolves seen in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Kor'kron Shredders are shredders that are used by Kor'kron Machinists in Siege of Orgrimmar.
Kor'kron Iron Scorpion is a scorpid seen in the Siege of Orgrimmar
Kor'kron Ironblades are orcs seen during the Nazgrim encounter in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Kor'kron Arcweavers are orcs seen during the Nazgrim encounter in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Kor'kron Blood Axes are orcs seen in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Kor'kron Dark Farseers are orcs seen in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Kor'kron Skullsplitters are orcs seen in the Siege of Orgrimmar. Some of them were corrupted.
Kor'kron Siegemasters are orcs seen in the Siege of Orgrimmar. They are piloting Hellscream Annihilators.
Kor'kron Iron Sentinels are orcs seen in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Kor'kron Machinists are orcs seen in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Kor'kron Jailers are orcs seen during the Thok the Bloodthirsty encounter in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
__NOTOC__ Konk is a hozen located in Nook of Konk of Jade Forest.
__NOTOC__ Kor'kron Hand Cannon drops from Malkorok in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
__NOTOC__ Kon-Kon is a hozen located at the Skyrange in the Valley of the Four Winds.

Kondal Huntsworn is a tauren skinning trainer found in Warspear's tauren district in Ashran. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, he relocated to the Legendary Leathers shop in Dalaran at the Broken Isles.

__NOTOC__ Koak Hoburn is the Horde chauffeur for the Chauffeured Chopper.
__NOTOC__ The Kobold Mastermind is a large purple Kobold found in The Oracle. When killed, it drops a Claws of Attack +12.
The Kor'kron Shaman's Treasure is a box that contains the Shaman-only cosmetic Dark Shaman set.
__NOTOC__ Kolrigg Stoktron is a dwarf quest giver located at the Southport in Spires of Arak.
__NOTOC__ Kobold Taskmasters are kobold creeps that can be encountered in many tilesets.
Kong Brewstep is a pandaren auctioneer located at Stormshield in Ashran.
Kor'gall's Hovel is an ogre mound located at Stonemaul Arena in Gorgrond. The hovel is the home of and contains the Throne of Stonemaul.
Koda's Sigil is fished from the fountain in Dalaran at the Broken Isles.
Kol'roz the Everburning can be found in the Felsurge Nest in Azsuna.

__NOTOC__ Koda Steelclaw is a night elf and one of the archdruids of Val'sharah. She is the leader of the Druids of the Claw and helps battle the Emerald Nightmare during the Val'sharah storyline. She is always in bear form.
Kor'kron Shock Forces are troops that can be recruited in Skyhold after completing Return of the Battlelord. Their Alliance counterpart are 7th Legion Shock Forces.
Kor'kron Headhunters are jungle trolls located on the The Sunstrider in Bladefist Bay in Durotar when it sailed to Azuremyst Isle.
The Kodo Calfling is a baby kodo owned by Gef. It is located in Dreadmist Camp in the Northern Barrens.
Kor'kron Supplies are found in Orgrimmar in Siege of Orgrimmar.
Kor'kron Flak Cannons are cannons located in Krasarang Wilds.
__NOTOC__ Koatini is a tuskarr located at the Grand Bazaar in Dazar'alor.
Kor'kron Mortars were mortars that the Kor'kron brought to attack Sen'jin Village in Durotar shortly before the events of Battlefield: Barrens.

Kodo Beast Riders are tauren riders that participated in the War of the Thorns. They first appeared with the Horde army led by Varok Saurfang in the Northern Barrens. Then they arrived to the secured Astranaar in Ashenvale with Varok and Warchief Sylvanas. They later arrived to Twilight Vale but remained behind the wisp wall while the main army was in Blackwood Den. They also joined the battle near the Wildbend River.

__NOTOC__ Kol'jun Deathwalker, also known as Kol'jun Deathserver, is a Zandalari troll ghost located at the Terrace of Sorrows in Nazmir. He and his wife were both priests of the loa Bwonsamdi at his shrine in Nazmir until they were slain by heretics who corrupted their son Kel'vax.

__NOTOC__ Kor'gall, Greatson of Kor'gall is an ogre descendant of Kor'gall. During the war between the Lightbound and the Mag'har, Kor'gall was allied with the Mag'har orc clans, however over the course of the war he became convinced that the Mag'har were doomed and seeking to protect his clan defected to the Lightbound. After his defection, he began an uprising against the Mag'har and was utlimately put down by Overlord Geya'rah, Eitrigg, and a Horde champion.

The Kor'gall clan is a clan of ogres who split from the Stonemaul clan. Under the leadership of Kor'gall, Greatson of Kor'gall, they would join the Lightbound and leave the to their fate. To try and stop the uprising of the ogre clan, Overlord Geya'rah goes to deal with him and finds where his allegiances lie. The remaining ogres may have regrouped with the Lightbound during their final assault on Hellsreach Citadel.
Kodo Rider Tanauk is a tauren located in Newstead in Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde. He provides Kodo War Beasts for 100 iron (Warfronts).

Kodo War Beast is a kodo located in Newstead in Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde. Kodo Rider Tanauk provides it for 100 iron (Warfronts). Once mounted, two orc drummers ride with the player.
Kor'kron Fire Brigades are goblins located in Assault on Zan'vess.
The Kobold Candle Helm is the appearance worn when the Whiskerwax Candle is used, but is not in and of itself obtainable. A blue and a green variety exists.
Kor'kron Battle Standard is a Kor'kron banner summoned by a Kor'kron Invoker.
Kono is a tortollan located in Zuldazar. At first he is found in a Nazeshi Cage in the Dreadpearl Shallows. He later shows up at the Seekers' Outpost.
Kolta is a tortollan located at Kennings Lodge in Tiragarde Sound.
Kojo's Master Matching Set was planned to drop from Tortollan Seekers Supplies.
Kogu is a tortollan located at Scaletrader Post in Zuldazar.
Kor'gar Wolfriders are orcs located in Kor'gar in Darkshore. They are also present during the Battle for Darkshore.
Kor'gar Shaman are orcs located in Kor'gar in Darkshore. They are also present during the Battle for Darkshore.

Kolkar Prisoners are centaur of the Kolkar clan held captive in a pen south of Magram Territory in Desolace. They immediately run out of the pen to freedom and despawn after the Magram Warden is killed.
The Kor'kron Lumber Piles are located in the Northern Barrens.
Kono Kelpcurl is a gilgoblin located in Deepsea Refuge in Nazjatar. He is initially saved as a Mind-Shackled Kelfin in the Deepsea Slave Pen.
The Kobold's Candles are looted from Blingtron 7000 Gift Package.
Kor'kron Slayers are orcs who accompanied Ishi to the Ruins of Korune in Kun-Lai Summit. They killed several Skyglaive Sentinels. Then a large number of them appeared at the Emperor's Reach.
Kofu is a Zandalari troll located at the Old Merchant Road in Zuldazar.
__NOTOC__ Kor'gall Agitators are ogres located in Stonemaul in Gorgrond.
__NOTOC__ Kor'gall Defectors are ogres located in Stonemaul in Gorgrond.
Kona is a house cat located in Exotic Imports in Dazar'alor.
Koba is a tortollan located at the Seekers' Outpost in Zuldazar.
Koja is a tortollan located in the Jeweled Coast in Stormsong Valley.
Kooma is a Zandalari troll found in the Mugambala in Zuldazar. She is sitting with Rooma and Dadooma on a wall.
Kor'kron Headhunters are jungle troll troops encountered by Alliance champions in Nazjatar.
__NOTOC__ Kobri is a steward located at Hero's Rest in Bastion.

Konthrogz the Obliterator is a rare elite worldeater devourer that spawns at several locations in Korthia. One of the objectives of Conquering Korthia, it spawns upon the conclusion of another Korthia vignette. Loot the devourer for 50x Relic Fragment, 8-14 rare-quality anima items (280-490 anima), and 5% progress for Shaping Fate. It also has a slim chance to drop the Rampaging Mauler mount, the Bound Worldeater Tendrils, Vambraces of the In-Between, Konthrogz's Scaled Handguards, and Visage of the Obliterator.
Konthrogz's Scaled Handguards drop from Konthrogz the Obliterator in Korthia.
Kor'kron Priests are Forsaken located in the Assault on Zan'vess.
Kolfinna is a Val'kyr located in Skyhold and later in the Maw. She was deemed worthy of carying out the wrath of Odyn during The Chosen Few.
The Kor'kron Cage Key drops from Mokvar the Treasurer in the Bank of Orgrimmar in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Kobold-Wrangler Legguards are a quest reward from Kobold Fury!.
Kor'kron Breastplate is a quest reward from Fate of the Queen's Reprisal (Horde).
Koh Riva is a jiro located in the Untamed Verdure in Zereth Mortis.
Koh Tissa is a jiro located in the Untamed Verdure in Zereth Mortis.
__NOTOC__ Koh Shira is a jiro located in the Untamed Verdure in Zereth Mortis.
Kooks is an otter located in the Eye of Azshara. Initially captured by the Violetsails and held in a Pet Cage, it is rescued by an adventurer, after which it is seen near Zantini.
Kofi is a steward quest giver located in the Eternal Forge in Bastion.
Kokia's Burnout Rod drops from Blazebound Firestorm in Ruby Life Pools.
Kodethi is a dracthyr located in the War Creche in the Forbidden Reach.
Kognir is a black drakonid located in the Obsidian Enclave in Valdrakken.

__NOTOC__ Konkhular is a rockfang located in a small cave by a river just south of the Wanderer's Steppe in the Ohn'ahran Plains. He has evaded Clan Shikaar's hunters for months thanks to his pelt, which camouflages him among his rocky surroundings.
__NOTOC__ Kokoslah is a dracthyr stable master located in Emberwatch in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Kodo Herder is a tauren located in Bloodhoof Village in Thunder Bluff. He is healing a Rowdy Kodo Calf.
Kor'kron Pilots are goblins located in the Assault on Zan'vess.
Kob'rok is a rare elite rock cobra that spawns in a cave southeast of Deephollow Lake in Zaralek Cavern.
Kor'kron Engineers are goblins located in the Assault on Zan'vess.
Kob'rok's Luminescent Scale drops from Kob'rok in Zaralek Cavern. It can be combined with the Ouroboros Tablet in order to create Salverun.
Kob'rok's Scale Sabatons drop from Kob'rok in Zaralek Cavern.

Kormek's Hut is a small hovel in north-central Desolace. It is inhabited by the odd pair of Willow and Bibbly F'utzbuckle. Willow, who can be found inside the hut, is a friendly member of the Twilight's Hammer. Bibbly greatly enjoys dancing around in the pen outside, excited by the potential profit of kodo bones (which also litter the pen). The location of the hut's namesake is unknown. The hut was once surrounded by barren flats, but post-Cataclysm is near the edge of a lush forest after the growth of the Cenarion Wildlands.

Korrak the Bloodrager (AKA Korrak the Everliving) is a dire troll and the leader of the Winterax tribe of ice trolls. He was sent by the Drakkari to represent the trolls as a fighter in the Amphitheater of Anguish in Zul'Drak. Formerly, Korrak controlled the Field of Strife in the middle of Alterac Valley. Later on, he left and took up residence near a troll graveyard after an avalanche nearly killed his tribe. There, he was potentially killed and raised several times.

:"My staff is a good one." Kralnor is the name of an orc warlock player character in the popular MMORPG World of Warcraft. His fame began when he posted a thread called "Warlock staff users" in the Warlock Forums of the Blizzard website May 16, 2005. The post asked readers to post information about the two-handed staff they preferred to use in the game. This idea was nothing new, however the manner in which Kralnor asked the readers to post was original. Since his last post, he has become a level 48 warlock, but has not logged in for some time. Similar posts include Alamo for druids, Mellin for paladins, and Halbrium for shamans.

Kraken, or krakken, are two different types of sea monsters. The first type are giant squid-like creatures with tentacles. The second type are more fish-like with giant fins and smaller in size. Aside from Azeroth, there are also kraken on the alternate Draenor.
__NOTOC__ Krang Stonehoof is a tauren warrior trainer located in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore.

Kranal Fiss is an orc quest giver located at Grol'dom Farm in the Northern Barrens. While he once aided young shaman seeking a mastery of fire alongside Telf Joolam, he now lets Rocco Whipshank's kodo caravans pass through his home, using the farm as a stop before reaching the Crossroads. He lives with his three children, Okla, Karu and Trok. He defended the farm during the Legion invasions.

__NOTOC__ Korran is a jungle troll located at the Crossroads in the Northern Barrens. He served Belgrom Rockmaul and was sent to the Barrens to watch over the land and take note of its happenings, studying the silithid at the Field of Giants. Moktar Krin is always looking out for him. He was rescued by an adventurer during the Legion invasions.
__NOTOC__ Kovork is a rare ogre found inside the cave at Boulder'gor in the Boulderfist Outpost in the Arathi Highlands. He is on a 5-8 hour respawn timer and drops the mace he is armed with.
Kosco Copperpinch is a goblin food and drink vendor located in Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands.

__NOTOC__ Korin Fel is an orc quest giver located in Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands. She is married to Drum Fel and can make auguries. The ogre Or'Kalar had an intense hatred for Drum, and wished nothing more than his death for defeating him years ago. Korin hid traces of Or'Kalar's presence in Stromgarde in order to avoid Drum falling into the ogre's trap.
Krakk is a goblin armor vendor located in Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn. It's notable how Krak in Dustwallow Marsh is an armorer while Krakk is a superior armorer.
__NOTOC__ Krak is an ogre armor vendor located in Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.
Krakle is a goblin quest giver located at Marshal's Stand in the Un'Goro Crater.
__NOTOC__ Kore is a draenei warrior trainer located at the Crash Site on Azuremyst Isle.
The Korg Bat drops from Mosh'Ogg Brutes at Mizjah Ruins in Northern Stranglethorn.
Kovic's Trading Satchel is a quest reward from The Undermarket (quest).
Kozzae is an MVP on the official forums. He posts as a level 60 male troll rogue from Doomhammer US.
Korran's Sealed Note was provided as an objective for The Swarm Grows.
Krakis was one of many orcs held in the internment camps following the end of the Second War. His status afterwards is unknown.
Korf is an undead polar bear and the companion of Isuldof Iceheart who can be found sleeping at his grave on the Shield Hill in Howling Fjord.
Koro the Wanderer is a taunka trade goods vendor located at Camp Oneqwah in the Grizzly Hills.
Korg the Cleaver is an orc food vendor and quest giver located at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin. He directs adventurers to bring him meat from the longneck grazers.

Kran & Conscience is an upcoming World of Warcraft machinima comedy created by Kranitoko Productions. The show is set to be released sometime in 2010/2011, but scripts are being made. Apt-T Productions has said that if the show is good, they will sign up and also release it in their name. The theme tune will be Jonathan Coulton — Code Monkey. The show revolves around an 18-year-old warrior who starts his journey around Azeroth, but soon meets a Conscience and agrees to take it back to its owner.

Koralon the Flame Watcher is a raid boss in the Vault of Archavon, released with patch 3.2. He became available when Season 7 started, on September 1 ([http://forums.worldofwarcraft.com/thread.html?sid=1&topicId=19110027050&ST=US-4930506-EcStuJbOxYG2LgjgcpOMWbNTktIsDcBFwku Season 6 ended on August 25th]). Like Archavon and Emalon, Koralon is only available to the faction that controls Wintergrasp Fortress. Also like Archavon and Emalon, he will despawn ten minutes before each fight for Wintergrasp starts. He does not despawn if he is already engaged in combat. The Kraken Tooth appears in players' inventories should they manage to kill the the during the -level daily quest Get Kraken! It starts the followup daily quest, Identifying the Remains. This quest can only be obtained when one has the previous quest in their log.
The Kor'kron Windragers are a group of wyvern riders located at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight. They are members of the elite Kor'kron Guard.
Korv is a tauren shaman, and is part of Theldren's team of gladiators at the Blackrock Depths arena.

Koron is a Forsaken serving the Dark Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. He owed Meryl Winterstorm a favor, however he repaid it by spying on Cho'gall and the Twilight's Hammer. He had a vampire bat which was stolen by Med'an.
Koroth's Banner is a quest item for Introductions Are in Order. It belonged to Koroth the Hillbreaker.

Korthun's End is a coral reef south of the Seabrush and directly above Darkbreak Cove in the Abyssal Depths. Sea life fills the area, including crabs, fish, sharks, sea turtles, rays and remoras. The Alliance have laid claim to this area.
Kor the Immovable is an elite earth elemental located in Shuddering Spires, northwest of Temple of Earth within Deepholm. He's within close proximity to Berracite.
Kranal's Vest is a quest reward from Crossroads Caravan Pickup.
Kor'winn Raitherun was captain of a merchant ship who at one time bought supplies from Jimmy Blackridge's family. He was killed from a Bloodsail Buccaneers raid on his ship.

Kova Broadhorn is a tauren shaman and novice alchemist. It seems that she once anticipated in a battle at Red Rocks. She has a kodo. When she could not make an elixir from Khadgar's Whisker and Blindweed, an Elixir of Greater Intellect, Bena Winterhoof offered her help but Kova refused. Eventually a Grimtotem tauren officially called her to see Magatha Grimtotem. Magatha sent her on a mission to find the reclusive orc seer Dhambeela, Magatha's personal friend, who was said to go far south of Mulgore. At first, Kova was scared but after Magatha told her that she will have a companion, she set out for a journey. She traveled to Ratchet to find the companion with a burning claw that Magatha pro
Korm Bonegrind is a notably large orc that appears on a Horde gunship in the worgen starting zone quest Endgame (quest). He would appear to be a mechanic based on his title.
Koroth's Den is a subzone of Gilneas. It is a hill southwest of the Stagecoach Crash Site where Koroth the Hillbreaker and his Ogre Minions reside.

Koroth the Hillbreaker is an ettin that worgen players meet during their starting zone questing. He is the meanest, most destructive force in all of Gilneas. He first appears alone near Crowley Orchard, apparently out to hunt for horses to eat. Worgen players thwart his attempts by guiding the horses away. Later on, he appears again, this time when the player leaves their stagecoach (which was on the road to Stormglen) at the crash site of a previous stagecoach. Liam Greymane develops a plan to stop the coming Forsaken squadron, namely stealing Koroth's banner from his den (just up the nearby hill) and planting the banner before the Forsaken. Koristrasza's Amulet is a quest reward from The Ritual (Razorfen Downs).

Korok the Colossus is an ettin who wanders the Northern Headlands of the Ruins of Gilneas near Forsaken Forward Command. Korok always spawns at the large tear in the Greymane Wall in the north of the Northern Headlands, this suggests that he's a native of Silverpine Forest who also used the Cataclysm as an opportunity to invade. It is also said that killing him grants the Forsaken Soldiers a brief relief, this suggests that he's specifically targeting them with his boulders, perhaps because his home in Silverpine was invaded by the Forsaken. He's said to have killed hundreds of Forsaken Soldiers. During the Horde questing in this zone, he will hurl boulders at the forces fighting in the Nort
__NOTOC__ Korla is an orc hunter trainer located in the Hunter's Hall in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar. She has a pet boar named Tusker.
Korrah's Report is provided by Cenarion Researcher Korrah to be delivered to Karnum Marshweaver for Official Assessment
Korok's Second Head drops from Korok the Colossus in the Ruins of Gilneas.

The Krasarang Wilds (or the Krasarang Jungle) along Pandaria's southern coast conceal many ancient secrets of a lost dynasty that have drawn the attention of prophecy-seekers among the Alliance and Horde. The Wilds are also home to the vicious, domineering mogu, and a more insidious danger still: the Sha of Despair is believed to have escaped from its bindings in the Temple of the Red Crane, and stifling gloom has begun to blanket the land in its path. In Patch 5.1.0 the beach on Krasarang Wilds erupted into a battlezone, full of Alliance and Horde siege machines.

Korga Strongmane is a tauren Skyseeker crash survivor found at Forlorn Hut on the Wandering Isle and the Horde representative to the pandaren of the Wandering Isle. He was a Horde prisoner until the Skyseeker crashed into Shen-zin Su, where he and his fellow prisoners helped the pandaren Ji Firepaw in removing the ship from the giant turtle's side. After getting back to Orgrimmar, Korga told the Horde about the deeds of Ji and the adventurer.
__NOTOC__ Krasari Huntresses are tigers found in Krasari Ruins and along Dojani River in the Krasarang Wilds.

Koro Mistwalker is a pandaren quest giver found in the Krasarang Wilds. Koro is a monk and student of the Red Crane. When the Sha of Despair is reawakened, Koro leads his fellow students in escaping its attack on the Temple of the Red Crane. He receives aid from Anduin Wrynn and adventurers in retaking the temple and saving the Red Crane. He is later seen helping defend against the mantid in Stoneplow in the Valley of the Four Winds.

The Krasarang Wilds storyline runs parallel to the Valley of the Four Winds storyline, starting about three quests in with Ken-Ken (quest) and Kang Bramblestaff (quest) acting as breadcrumbs to the zone. is the first quest giver encountered on the road coming out of the Valley of the Four Winds heading toward Zhu's Watch. The progression of the storyline is tracked in the achievement Mighty Roamin' Krasaranger. After reaching the end of both halves of the storyline, adventurers are sent up to Stoneplow on the west side of Valley of the Four Winds. Korjan Reavers are mogu found at the Ruins of Korja in the Krasarang Wilds. Some are attacking Dawnchaser Retreat, fighting against Dawnchaser Hunters, and Sentinel Basecamp, fighting against Wounded Sentinels.

__NOTOC__ The Korjan Reclaimers are mogu of the Korjan clan found at the Ruins of Korja and Field of Korja in Krasarang Wilds. They are unearthing artifacts and using portals connected to Kun-Lai Summit to bring in supplies and reinforcements, and send their captives through to the other side to work elsewhere.
Korjan Collectors are mogu located in the Field of Korja in the Krasarang Wilds.

The Krasari Ruins can be found between the Zhu Province, Thunder Cleft and the Incursion in eastern Krasarang Wilds. Chezin Dawnchaser is found here poisoned by the mogu. Daggle Bombstrider has crash-landed at the ruins' southwestern extent.

The Krasari Falls, fed by the Yan-Zhe River in Valley of the Four Winds, feeds the Krasarang River in northwestern Krasarang Wilds. Behind the waterfall is the Riverblade Den, home to the Riverblade saurok. Fallsong Village can be found just to the southwest of the falls on the river.
__NOTOC__ Kor'thik Timberhusks are mantid located at the Dusklight Bridge in Townlong Steppes.
__NOTOC__ Kor'thik Fleetwings are mantid located in the Farwatch Overlook in Townlong Steppes.
__NOTOC__ Kor'thik Swarmers are mantid found at Farwatch Overlook in Townlong Steppes. They are also in the Heart of Fear.
Korvexxis is a mantid located in Townlong Steppes. He gets ambushed by Taoshi to retrieve a crystal to open a door.

Krasarang Cove is a large cove on the southeastern shore of Krasarang Wilds. The Silken Shore of Jade Forest is to the east, Zhu Province is to the north, while the Turtle Beach is to the west. Seaspittle Nook is at the north end of the cove. This became the landing site for the Alliance forces in order to build Lion's Landing.

__NOTOC__ Kovok is the kunchong pet and partner of Kaz'tik the Manipulator. The mantid used to use force to control kunchong, but Kaz'tik realized that they were intelligent creatures and that his people didn't fully understand them. He thus bonded with a young Kovok and formed a partnership with the creature. When Kaz'tik was chosen for encasement as a paragon, he didn't want to risk his experiment, so he studied the notes kept by Korven the Prime on his development of the preservation chamber. Kaz'tik was able to create a modified version that could preserve Kovok as well, and thus continue his experiment where he left off when he was called on by the Klaxxi in the future.

Kor'vess is a mantid settlement in Kypari Kor, the giant kypari tree on the northern border of the Dread Wastes with Townlong Steppes. It provides the mantid swarm with most of its amber. Clockwise from the north is the Dusklight Bridge, the Sunset Brewgarden, the Horrid March, Fear Clutch, the Clutches of Shek'zeer, the Heart of Fear, Rikkitun Village, and the Widening Deep of Townlong Steppes. The Heartroot of Kypari Kor can be found inside the northeastern entrance of the tree, while the Mark of the Empress can be found in the eastern entrance of the kypari. The Kor'kron elemental camp is found immediately to the northeast of Ratchet in the Northern Barrens. The Kor'kron have set up camp here to stir up unbound earth elementals and hell hounds for the cause. Right next to the camp is an abandoned gold mine that was previously occupied by Peons and Horde Guards. During the Burning Legion's invasions, the abandoned camp fell under the Legion's control.

The Kor'kron meat camp is found just northwest of Crossroads in the Northern Barrens. The Kor'kron are butchering the local wildlife for meat to feed the rest of the organization as well as leather. The wildlife includes tallstriders, Zhevra Runners, Barrens Kodo, and Barrens Giraffes. During the Burning Legion's invasion, the abandoned camp fell under the Legion's control. They turned the area into some sort of prison, with many dead Captured Civilians and encaged Plains Travelers, Orc Captives and Imprisoned Trolls.

The Kor'kron refinery is found south of the Sludge Fen in the Northern Barrens. The Kor'kron have turned the area into an oil refinery. During the Burning Legion's invasion, the abandoned camp fell under the Legion's control.

The Kor'kron lumber yard is found overlooking the Dry Hills southwest of the Mor'shan Rampart in the northeast corner of the Northern Barrens, just south of the border with Ashenvale. The Kor'kron have unleashed shredders to gather lumber for the Kor'kron war effort. Following the defeat of the Kor'kron's master, Garrosh Hellscream, the camp was left deserted. During the Burning Legion's final invasion, the abandoned camp fell under the Legion's control.
